title.zh: 欧盟把AI算力扩张与电网灵活性同时推进，数据中心开始成为能源规划的一部分
title.en: The EU is linking AI-compute expansion with grid flexibility, making data centres part of energy planning

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会近期公布电气化行动计划，明确指出AI工厂、AI超级工厂和数据中心的增长需要更灵活、更清洁且更有韧性的电力系统。对行业而言，算力基础设施不再只是服务器和芯片采购问题，而是同时涉及并网容量、储能、现场可再生能源、负荷调节和跨境能源数据。未来数据中心项目的竞争力，可能取决于能否把计算负荷与电力市场、网络约束和碳排放管理协调起来。
summary.en: The European Commission’s recent electrification action plan links the growth of AI factories, gigafactories, and data centres to a more flexible, cleaner, and resilient electricity system. Compute infrastructure is therefore no longer only a server and chip procurement issue; it also involves grid capacity, storage, on-site renewables, demand flexibility, and cross-border energy data. The competitiveness of future data-centre projects may depend on coordinating compute loads with power markets, network constraints, and carbon management.

watch.zh: 关注AI算力项目能否把并网、储能和负荷灵活性纳入项目级基础设施设计。
watch.en: Watch whether AI-compute projects include grid connection, storage, and load flexibility in infrastructure design.

title.zh: 欧盟启动15亿欧元电池制造融资工具，产业政策转向支持从试生产到商业化爬坡
title.en: The EU launches a €1.5 billion battery facility to support the ramp from pilot production to commercial scale

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会启动Battery Booster Facility，为欧洲经济区符合条件的电池电芯制造项目提供最高15亿欧元的无息贷款，申请截止时间为2026年9月30日。政策重点不是单纯扩大产能，而是解决电池项目从中试、首批量产到商业运行之间的资金和交付风险。对工程和基础设施团队，电池工厂意味着洁净环境、热管理、消防、危险品分区、能源质量和供应链韧性需要在早期一体化设计。
summary.en: The European Commission has launched the Battery Booster Facility, offering up to €1.5 billion in interest-free loans for eligible battery-cell manufacturing projects in the European Economic Area, with applications open until 30 September 2026. The policy targets the financing and delivery risks between pilot production, first commercial batches, and full operation rather than capacity alone. For engineering and infrastructure teams, battery plants require early integration of clean environments, thermal management, fire safety, hazardous-area zoning, power quality, and supply-chain resilience.

watch.zh: 关注融资工具能否降低电池项目从试产线到稳定量产阶段的工程和质量爬坡风险。
watch.en: Watch whether the facility reduces engineering and quality risks during the ramp from pilot lines to stable production.

liveUpdates.reference: European Commission Battery Booster Facility, July 2026

title.zh: 欧盟AI网络安全行动计划把模型风险与关键基础设施防护放到同一治理框架
title.en: The EU’s AI-cybersecurity plan places model risk and critical-infrastructure protection in one governance framework

summary.zh: 欧盟委员会发布AI网络安全行动计划，强调先进AI既能帮助发现漏洞，也可能自动化攻击、扩大事件速度和规模。对企业和公共基础设施而言，AI系统的风险不只来自模型输出，还来自训练数据、工具调用、供应链依赖和部署后的权限边界。行业下一步要看的，是安全测试、监管沙盒、关键系统分级和事件响应能否真正落到采购条款、软件更新和运营责任，而不是停留在原则性声明。
summary.en: The European Commission’s AI cybersecurity action plan notes that advanced AI can help detect vulnerabilities but can also automate attacks and increase their speed and scale. For businesses and public infrastructure, AI risk comes not only from model output but also from training data, tool access, supply-chain dependencies, and post-deployment permissions. The next test is whether security testing, regulatory sandboxes, critical-system classification, and incident response become procurement, update, and operational requirements rather than remaining principles.

watch.zh: 关注AI治理要求能否转化为软件供应链、权限控制和关键基础设施运维中的可验证措施。
watch.en: Watch whether AI governance becomes verifiable practice in software supply chains, access control, and critical-infrastructure operations.

title.zh: 抗震设计正在从单一强度验算转向损伤、功能和恢复路径的联合表达
title.en: Earthquake design is moving from single strength checks toward joint descriptions of damage, function, and recovery

insights.evidence: PEER performance-based engineering programme and 2026 research on integrated reliability and resilience assessment

summary.zh: 性能化抗震工程的重点不只是预测构件是否屈服，而是把地震危险性、结构损伤、人员安全、修复成本和恢复时间连接起来。PEER长期推动性能化工程技术，2026年的研究进一步讨论如何把可靠性与震后恢复纳入统一评估。对结构工程师，这意味着模型输出要从“最大层间位移是多少”扩展到“哪些构件损伤、何时可修、功能如何恢复”。局限在于损伤状态和恢复模型高度依赖地方数据、维修资源和社会功能假设，不能把一个建筑的结果直接外推。
summary.en: Performance-based earthquake engineering is not only about predicting whether members yield; it connects hazard, structural damage, life safety, repair cost, and recovery time. PEER has long developed performance-based methods, while 2026 research is extending the discussion toward integrated reliability and post-event recovery assessment. For structural engineers, outputs must expand from maximum drift to which components are damaged, when they can be repaired, and how function returns. The limitation is that damage and recovery models depend heavily on local data, repair capacity, and assumptions about social function; one building’s result cannot be directly generalised.

caveat.zh: 性能目标和恢复模型的可信度取决于地方危险性、构件脆弱性和维修资源数据，不能只依赖软件默认参数。
caveat.en: Performance and recovery models depend on local hazard, component fragility, and repair-resource data; software defaults are not sufficient.

referenceLinks.label: arXiv: Integrated reliability and resilience assessment

title.zh: 抗震节点的关键风险常常发生在重复塑性变形，而不是第一次达到屈服的瞬间
title.en: For seismic joints, the critical risk often lies in repeated plastic deformation rather than first yield

insights.evidence: University of Arkansas Steel Structures Research Laboratory work on ultra-low-cycle fatigue and ductile frames

summary.zh: 地震作用下，钢构件和节点可能经历多次反复塑性变形，局部屈曲、延性断裂和焊接细节损伤会逐步累积。阿肯色大学结构钢研究实验室把超低周疲劳、延性断裂和抗震框架作为重点，反映出设计判断正在从静力极限强度扩展到循环耗能和破坏顺序。对工程师而言，节点设计需要同时理解应变集中、构造细节、材料韧性、试验验证和分析模型的适用范围。低周疲劳模型能帮助比较方案，但不能取代关键节点的细部设计和质量控制。
summary.en: Under earthquake loading, steel members and joints may undergo repeated plastic deformation, with local buckling, ductile fracture, and weld-detail damage accumulating over cycles. The University of Arkansas Steel Structures Research Laboratory focuses on ultra-low-cycle fatigue, ductile fracture, and seismic frame behaviour, reflecting a shift from static ultimate strength toward cyclic energy dissipation and failure sequence. Engineers need to understand strain concentration, detailing, material toughness, testing, and model applicability together. Low-cycle fatigue models help compare options but do not replace critical-detail design and quality control.

caveat.zh: 低周疲劳结果对加载历史、焊接缺陷、残余应力和材料批次敏感；试验结论应限定在适用构造范围内。
caveat.en: Low-cycle fatigue results are sensitive to loading history, weld defects, residual stress, and material batch; test conclusions need a defined detailing range.

insights.reference: University of Arkansas steel infrastructure research

title.zh: 火灾工程的下一阶段是把热作用、材料退化和震后或火后功能恢复放入同一决策链
title.en: The next stage of fire engineering is linking thermal action, material degradation, and post-fire recovery

insights.evidence: University research on fire-induced concrete spalling and structural resilience under extreme loading

summary.zh: 火灾后评估不能只看混凝土表面颜色或一个残余强度折减系数。温度梯度、爆裂、钢筋粘结退化、构件变形和火后含水状态会共同影响剩余承载力与可修复性。UQ等研究团队持续关注火致混凝土爆裂和防火工程，说明工程实践需要把材料检测、损伤分区、结构重分析和维修方案结合起来。对未来结构工程师，重要能力是区分可观测损伤与不可观测退化，并把不确定性转化为检查、加固或拆除决策，而不是给出过度精确的单一剩余容量。
summary.en: Post-fire assessment cannot rely on surface colour or one residual-strength reduction factor. Temperature gradients, spalling, bond degradation, member deformation, and post-fire moisture jointly affect residual capacity and repairability. Research at UQ and other groups on fire-induced concrete spalling shows that practice needs to combine material testing, damage zoning, structural re-analysis, and repair planning. For future structural engineers, the key capability is distinguishing observable damage from hidden degradation and converting uncertainty into inspection, strengthening, or demolition decisions rather than presenting an over-precise single residual capacity.

caveat.zh: 火后材料参数和构件边界条件具有明显不确定性；任何剩余承载力结论都应说明检测范围、模型假设和安全边界。
caveat.en: Post-fire material properties and member boundaries are highly uncertain; residual-capacity conclusions must state inspection scope, model assumptions, and safety boundaries.

referenceLinks.label: Utah State: Materials and structures research

title.zh: 隔震不是把结构“放软”：中国与国际设计如何处理周期、位移与耗能？
title.en: Seismic isolation is not simply making a structure soft: how Chinese and international design treat period, displacement, and energy dissipation

text.zh: 隔震设计通过在基础或结构层间引入柔性、滑移或耗能装置，改变地震输入到上部结构的传递方式。中国、美国和欧洲规范虽然在隔震层参数、位移需求、复位能力、风荷载约束和试验要求上表达不同，但共同关注三个问题：结构周期是否被有效拉长，隔震层位移是否可容纳，装置和上部结构是否具有稳定的耗能与复位能力。隔震并不是简单降低刚度，因为周期变长可能增加位移需求，装置性能也会随速度、温度、老化和循环次数变化。工程比较应同时看力学目标、构造细节、试验认证和震后可更换性。
text.en: Seismic isolation changes how earthquake input reaches the superstructure by introducing flexibility, sliding, or energy-dissipating devices at the foundation or between structural levels. Chinese, US, and European provisions express isolator parameters, displacement demand, restoring capability, wind constraints, and testing differently, but all address three questions: whether the period is effectively lengthened, whether isolation displacement can be accommodated, and whether devices and the superstructure provide stable dissipation and recentering. Isolation is not simply reducing stiffness: a longer period can increase displacement demand, while device properties vary with velocity, temperature, ageing, and cycling. A meaningful comparison considers mechanics, detailing, qualification tests, and post-earthquake replaceability together.

label.zh: 周期变化不等于风险自动降低
label.en: A longer period does not automatically reduce risk

text.zh: 隔震可能降低上部结构加速度，但会把变形和位移需求集中到隔震层，必须同时检查间隙、管线和连接。
text.en: Isolation may reduce superstructure acceleration but concentrates deformation and displacement demand at the isolation level, requiring checks of gaps, utilities, and connections.

label.zh: 装置性能是随时间变化的

text.zh: 速度、温度、老化、磨损和循环次数会影响刚度、阻尼和复位能力，试验与维护不能被视为附属工作。
text.en: Velocity, temperature, ageing, wear, and cycle count affect stiffness, damping, and recentering; testing and maintenance are part of the design logic.

label.zh: 上部结构仍需合理延性
label.en: The superstructure still needs appropriate ductility

text.zh: 隔震减少输入不代表上部结构可以忽略构造延性、偶然偏心和非结构构件保护。
text.en: Reduced input does not allow the superstructure to ignore ductile detailing, accidental eccentricity, or non-structural protection.

takeaway.zh: 中外隔震设计的共同逻辑是重新分配地震能量和变形，而不是单纯降低结构刚度。真正的设计质量取决于位移容纳、装置性能证据、复位能力、维护路径和上部结构的整体协调。
takeaway.en: The shared logic of isolation design is to redistribute seismic energy and deformation, not simply reduce stiffness. Design quality depends on displacement accommodation, device-performance evidence, recentering, maintenance access, and coordination with the superstructure.

title.zh: 参考实例：单自由度体系的周期与恢复力概念筛查
title.en: Worked reference: conceptual period and restoring-force screening for a single-degree-of-freedom system

intro.zh: 以下关系来自基本动力学，是用于说明隔震概念的派生关系，不是某一规范的编号公式。正式设计应按适用规范确定地震输入、非线性装置参数、位移需求、复位、风荷载、碰撞间隙和试验要求。
intro.en: The relations below come from basic dynamics and are derived relations for explaining isolation concepts, not numbered equations from one standard. Formal design must determine seismic input, nonlinear device properties, displacement demand, recentering, wind, impact gaps, and testing under the applicable provisions.

label.zh: 线性等效周期（派生关系）

citation.zh: Derived relation：以质量m和等效刚度k说明周期变化；实际隔震装置通常具有非线性、速度相关和幅值相关特性。
citation.en: Derived relation: illustrates period change using mass m and equivalent stiffness k; real isolation devices commonly have nonlinear, velocity-dependent, and amplitude-dependent properties.

citation.zh: Derived relation：用于表达第i个理想化装置的恢复力；正式模型应采用试验或规范认可的滞回关系。
citation.en: Derived relation: expresses the restoring force of an idealised device i; formal models should use tested or code-recognised hysteresis relationships.

citation.zh: Simplified screen：表示设计作用效应与设计抗力的比值；η不是隔震设计的通用验收常数，具体限值必须按适用规范和装置认证确定。
citation.en: Simplified screen: ratio of design action effect to design resistance. η is not a universal isolation-design acceptance constant; limits must come from the applicable standard and device qualification.

note.zh: 例如，若体系质量m=1,000 t、等效刚度k=1,000 kN/m，则概念周期T≈6.28 s。若某理想化装置刚度kᵢ=400 kN/m、位移uᵢ=0.25 m，则恢复力Fᵢ=100 kN。该算例只用于说明参数关系，不能替代非线性时程分析、装置试验、碰撞和管线协调。
note.en: For example, with system mass m=1,000 t and equivalent stiffness k=1,000 kN/m, the conceptual period is T≈6.28 s. If an idealised device has kᵢ=400 kN/m and displacement uᵢ=0.25 m, its restoring force is Fᵢ=100 kN. This only illustrates parameter relationships; it does not replace nonlinear time-history analysis, device testing, impact, or utility coordination.
